zh.title: NASA選三項月球探測任務 測冰與環境
zh.summary: NASA選定三項月球實驗；測冰、探查熔岩管與環境
body: NASA已選定三項新實驗，將透過商業月球酬載服務計畫送往月球表面，任務包括尋找冰、調查可能的地下熔岩管，以及量測月球表面的環境危害，為太空人未來長期駐留月球做準備。
這三項調查是透過NASA的月球表面酬載與研究調查計畫（PRISM）選出。NASA科學任務理事會副署長Nicky Fox表示，這項計畫是要建立一套「星際生存指南」，讓科學資料與安全措施能事先送到月球表面。
其中一項名為DISCO的探測將在微型冷阱區域搜尋冰，評估月球表面的穩定性，以及火箭排氣在降落與起飛期間揚起土壤的影響。DISCO由NASA艾姆斯研究中心的Ariel Deutsch主導。
第二項調查為GIMLI，將送往Marius Hills Pit，利用地球物理量測判斷該坑洞是否通往更大的地下熔岩管，以評估是否可作為未來太空人與設備的天然遮蔽。此調查由行星科學研究所的Nathaniel Putzig主導。
第三項調查將部署於月球南極附近，監視可能影響未來表面作業的條件。NASA尚未公佈具體的任務時間表。

en.title: NASA picks three lunar experiments to hunt ice, probe lava tube, assess hazards
en.summary: NASA selects three Moon experiments to find ice, investigate a possible underground lava tube, and measure environmental hazards.
body: NASA has selected three new experiments to find ice, investigate a possible underground lava tube, and measure environmental hazards on the Moon, as the agency prepares for astronauts to eventually live and work there for extended periods.

The investigations will be delivered to the lunar surface through NASA's Commercial Lunar Payload Services programme. They were selected through NASA's Payloads and Research Investigations on the Surface of the Moon, or PRISM, programme.

One experiment, the Depth Imager with Spectral and Color Optics (DISCO), will search for ice in small areas known as micro-cold traps, examine surface stability, and study how rocket exhaust interacts with the soil during landings and departures. DISCO is led by Ariel Deutsch of NASA's Ames Research Center.

The second investigation, the Geophysical Investigation for Mapping Lunar Interior (GIMLI), will be sent to the Marius Hills Pit. It will use geophysical measurements to determine whether the pit opens into a larger underground lava tube. The investigation is led by Nathaniel Putzig of the Planetary Science Institute.
A third investigation will be positioned near the lunar South Pole and will monitor conditions that could affect surface operations. The schedule for the missions has not been announced by NASA.

zh.title: 史特拉斯堡球場用30架退役A340打造遮陽立面
zh.summary: 30架退役A340機身鋁材製成196片遮陽板
body: 斯特拉斯堡競賽俱樂部（Racing Club de Strasbourg Alsace）重返改建後的Stade de la Meinau球場時，看臺上方將出現由退役客機零件組成的南立面。本案由國際體育建築事務所Populous與總部在斯特拉斯堡的Rey-de-Crécy合作設計。
改建工程將30架退役空中巴士A340廣體客機的機體鋁材裁切改造為196片遮陽板，覆蓋約4,050平方公尺的朝南立面，作為「遮陽板」（brise-soleil）裝置，控制太陽輻射並降低熱量。
據報導，此構想源於COVID-19新型冠狀病毒肺炎疫情期間全球機隊停飛之際；TARMAC Aerosave參與材料準備，製作出長約6公尺、寬約2.5公尺的大型切段。目前個別飛機身分（如註冊編號）尚未對外公佈。
尚無可靠公共證據顯示此立面來自特定航空公司的機隊，或可追溯至具名的個別飛機。

en.title: Strasbourg football stadium reuses 30 retired Airbus A340 fuselage panels for new shield
en.summary: Racing Club Strasbourg's stadium reuses 196 panels of 30 retired Airbus A340s
body: When Racing Club de Strasbourg Alsace returns to its newly transformed Stade de la Meinau, parts of former passenger aircraft will form the stadium's new southern facade, designed by international sports architecture practice Populous in collaboration with Strasbourg-based Rey-de-Crécy.

The redevelopment incorporates sections of 30 decommissioned Airbus A340 wide-body airliners, cut and re-engineered into 196 individual panels covering approximately 4,050 square metres of the south-facing façade, forming a brise-soleil.

According to designboom, the idea originated during the COVID-19 pandemic; TARMAC Aerosave, the aviation maintenance and recycling company, has produced large sections approximately six metres high by 2.5 metres wide.

The individual aircraft identities, however, have not been publicly released, and there is no reliable public evidence that the façade consists of one particular airline's fleet or can be traced to named aircraft.
